patch.value: CI step 'Verify generated changelog is current' failed on both Node 22 and 26 for PR 135. Reproduced locally: prepend-mode check renders the six Fixed entries in completion-descending order while the committed replace-mode file hoists the two items carrying an explicit release field. Same entries, different order, so the diff never closes.
changelog:check verified in prepend mode against a replace-mode CHANGELOG, making the gate unsatisfiable

The changelog:check script ran the prepend-mode generator with --check, but CHANGELOG.md is generated by changelog:full in replace mode. The two modes order and select entries differently, so the check reported the file out of date and no regeneration could ever satisfy it.
npm run changelog:check passes against the committed CHANGELOG.md, and the script verifies the same mode that generates the file

patch.value: The changelog:check script ran the prepend-mode generator with --check, but CHANGELOG.md is generated by changelog:full in replace mode. The two modes render the same items differently, so the check reported the file out of date and no regeneration could ever satisfy it. In this repository the difference surfaced purely as entry ordering; the modes also differ in selection, which is what the fleet sweep surfaced elsewhere.
